svg.text: “1 in 4 sellers in Broward has already cut.”
— what ‘Sellers won't come down on price.’ usually means

21.7% of active listings in Broward have a recent price reduction. In Coral Ridge waterfront (33306) it's 27.4%. Every single ZIP in the area showed an INCREASE in price-cut share this month versus last. The negotiating posture sellers project in person isn't what their listings show on the MLS — the table is more open than it sounds.
